title: Conditions of Intake and Custody, Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Conditions of Intake and Custody

Every piece brought to Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services is taken in on the conditions below. Each service carries a ceiling on the value a piece may be taken in at, an amount the chain answers for while the piece is in its care, its own rule on appointments and home visits, a travel fee where the appraiser attends away from a store, and a limit on how many engagements one customer may have running under that service at once. Money figures are in USD.

| Service | Highest declared value a piece is taken in at | Amount the chain answers for while the piece is in its care | Taken in by appointment only | Appraiser attends the customer's home | Travel fee for attending away from a store | Engagements one customer may have running under this service at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | 10000 | 10000 | No | No | 0 | 2 |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | 50000 | 50000 | No | No | 0 | 3 |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | 100000 | 100000 | Yes | No | 0 | 3 |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | 250000 | 250000 | Yes | Yes | 350 | 2 |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | 500000 | 500000 | Yes | No | 0 | 2 |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | 2000000 | 2000000 | Yes | Yes | 750 | 1 |

## Conditions on which each service is engaged

| Service | Engaged only where |
|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | the declared value is no more than 10000 and no written report is wanted |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | the declared value is no more than 50000 and a graduate gemologist is required |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | the declared value is no more than 100000, a graduate gemologist is required and the piece is brought in by appointment |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | the declared value is no more than 250000, a certified appraiser is required and the piece is brought in by appointment |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | the declared value is no more than 500000, the stone is loose or can be removed from its mounting, and an outside laboratory is used |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | the declared value is no more than 2000000, a master appraiser is required, the pieces are brought in by appointment and the engagement covers at least 10 pieces |

## Points on the ceiling and the travel fee

- At every service the amount the chain answers for while the piece is in its care equals the highest declared value that service takes in.
- Declared values of 50000 and of 49999 both sit within the Insurance Replacement Appraisal ceiling; a declared value of 50001 sits above it and within the Fair Market Value Appraisal ceiling of 100000.
- A travel fee arises only at the two services whose appraiser attends the customer's home: 350 at the Estate and Probate Appraisal and 750 at the Collection Portfolio Appraisal. The other four services carry no travel fee and no home visit.
- Only the Verbal Counter Estimate and the Insurance Replacement Appraisal take a piece in without an appointment.
- A collection of 9 pieces does not meet the minimum of 10 pieces on which a Collection Portfolio Appraisal is engaged; a collection of 10 pieces does.
